reason: My diary has run for years and I trust it more than any phone. I take orders at the counter in Hindi and local item names, and I don't believe a machine will get them right.
objection: Will it understand my Hindi, my regional words and my item names? If it logs one wrong udhaar entry I will have to check everything against my diary anyway, and then I am doing double work.
would_change_my_mind: Let me try it free on my own voice notes for a few weeks, side by side with my diary, and see it get my item names and udhaar amounts right without mistakes.
